_comment: Dependencies are updated by Renovate pull requests, one batch per schedule, so an update lands with a Vercel preview build to look at rather than as a surprise during a deploy.

packageRules._comment: Routine updates arrive together. A green preview build is enough to merge a patch, and reviewing forty separate pull requests teaches nobody anything.
The framework boundary deserves its own review: Next, React, and their types move together and break together.
The toolchain changes how the code is checked, not what the site does, so it updates apart from the runtime.
